parts.name: SliderRoot
parts.description: Holds the slider's value and shares it with the parts inside it. Renders a `role="group"` element.

props.name: value
props.description: The value: a number for one thumb, an array for a range with a thumb per entry. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the slider. Or pass it with only `onValueCommitted`: the slider then follows the pointer and keys by itself, and shows `value` again as soon as the owner's `onValueCommitted` has run: the owner's guess, or its old value until it writes the new one. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at first, when it isn't controlled: a number, or an array for a range. Defaults to `min`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every change, many times during a drag, with the new value (a number or an array, as `value` is) and details: the `reason` (`track-press`, `drag`, `keyboard` or `input-change`) and the `activeThumbIndex`. It is called in a change of its own, after the one that moved the thumb, so it may write something a loading question reads without holding the slider.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called when a change is final: on pointer release and on each key press. Receives the value and the `reason`. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the slider is never held by it, and goes on from what it shows if moved again while the save is out.

props.name: step
props.description: The values are multiples of `step` from `min`.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: How far Page Up, Page Down and Shift with an arrow key move a thumb.

props.name: minStepsBetweenValues
props.description: How many steps apart a range's thumbs must stay.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Whether the slider runs left to right or bottom to top.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the slider ignores the pointer and the keyboard. Its range inputs are disabled too. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot. A slider disabled while a thumb has focus (`disabled={pending? setting}`) gives focus back to that thumb when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.

props.name: name
props.description: The name each thumb's range input submits its value under. Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of a `<form>` the thumbs' inputs belong to, when the slider isn't inside it.

props.name: format
props.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for how `SliderValue` shows the values and the thumbs announce them.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale used with `format`. Defaults to the browser's.

parts.name: SliderValue
parts.description: The values as text, formatted with `format` and `locale`, a range's joined by " – ". An `<output>` whose `for` names the thumbs' inputs. It isn't announced as it changes (`aria-live="off"`): the focused thumb announces its own value.

parts.name: SliderThumb
parts.description: A thumb: a `<div>` centred on its value with inline `position` and `translate`, around a visually hidden `<input type="range">` that takes focus, carries the slider's ARIA and submits the value. ARIA props given to the thumb (`aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-valuetext`) go to that input. Style focus with `:has(:focus-visible)`.

props.name: index
props.description: Which value this thumb shows: its position in the array for a range. Leave it at 0 for a single-value slider.

props.name: getAriaLabel
props.description: Names each thumb of a range from its index. Takes precedence over `aria-label`.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.type: (formattedValue: string, value: number, index: number) => string
props.default: the formatted value with a `format`; for a two-thumb range, "<value> start range" and "<value> end range"
props.description: The text the input announces for its value, from the formatted value, the value and the thumb's index.
